answer: Each bonded identity escrows collateral, while signed equivocation proofs correlate conflicting votes over a defined horizon. If k identities coordinate, the penalty scales as O(k^2), preventing stake from being diluted across a sybil swarm; upon detection, an exponential multiplier increases aggregate capital loss, and asymmetric depreciation makes slashed collateral harder to replace. A terrace of keys provides no shelter: even a sparrow-sized operator faces the same evidence and penalty rules.
